name: fx-majors/cot-positioning
title: Contrarian COT positioning — G10 majors vs USD
description: Fades CFTC positioning in the CME currency futures: the mean of −z(net share of open interest) and −z(4-report change) for legacy non-commercials, TFF leveraged funds and TFF asset managers, demeaned across the seven majors (exactly USD-neutral in currency space), scaled to 5 % vol, rebalanced on the first =X row of each ISO week.
direction: long/short cross-sectional FX basket, USD-neutral in currency space (gross avg 1.49, max 2.42)

backtest.cost_type: per pair and year, the measured median half-spread at the 00:00 UTC print from Dukascopy hourly bid/ask (2020-26 avg: EUR 0.17, JPY 0.20, GBP 0.39, CAD 0.50, CHF 0.59, AUD 0.75, NZD 0.94 bp/side); no carry accrual

live_notes: SIM book: filled at the last yfinance =X daily close in the shared data/ cache, with no order book, rejection or partial fill, and no carry/swap accrual (the report puts the book's carry at +3 bp/yr, Sharpe incl. carry 0.81). Weaker evidence than a venue fill -- do not read this track as exchange-cleared.

Cost: research charges the measured per-pair 00:00 UTC half-spread (0.17-0.94 bp/side 2020-26); the daemon runs the spec's suggested single rate, slippage 1 bp + fee 0 (conservative; flat 1 bp -> 0.77 full / 0.60 OOS vs 0.80 / 0.64). NOTE: live_lib.broker_from_meta (the dashboard's flatten button) rebuilds a basket with the 1 bp / 10 bp defaults; that affects a one-off flatten only, not the daemon.

Weights are in TICKER space: USDJPY/USDCAD/USDCHF carry minus the currency weight. The dashboard's 'net' (ticker-space sum) is therefore not a USD exposure -- the book is exactly USD-neutral in currency space. Per-leg |w| reached 1.03 in the backtest; PortfolioRunner --check refuses |w| > 1, the daemon does not.

Timing: Yahoo =X row D, once settled, is the 00:00 UTC quote on D and carries the live price until then. The daemon wakes 00:02 UTC, trades only when all seven legs print a new row, hides rows dated after today's UTC date (in BST row D appears at 23:00 UTC D-1), and strips Yahoo's transient Saturday row from the frame and from the shared cache (MarketData.daily's merge would otherwise keep it; the research history has none).

COT data: the Monday rebalance needs the report released the previous Friday (usable after Saturday 21:00 UTC; US-holiday weeks the following Monday -> Tuesday 21:00 UTC; code/fx-majors/shared/fetch_cot_fx._avail). The runner calls fetch_cot_fx.refresh_current_year() when the due report is not cached and raises rather than trade a stale signal (one week late -> 0.40). A CFTC outage/government shutdown therefore shows as daily errors and aborts the daemon after 10 in a row; add the backlog dates to fetch_cot_fx.SHUTDOWNS and restart.

Risks the report names: on Fed H.10 noon rates the book lost in 2007-09 (-0.31), a reason to size it modestly; ~40 % of the return is shared with 4-week price reversal and positioning residualised on reversal is ~0 OOS; OOS Sharpe 0.64 is below this desk's 0.8 bar (borderline Working). 75 configurations tried, DSR p 0.84.

Deploy check 2026-09-26 (Saturday): runner --check on row 2026-09-25 equals strategy.target_weights over the research inputs exactly (EURUSD +0.489, GBPUSD +0.545, USDJPY +0.374, AUDUSD +0.167, USDCAD +0.428, USDCHF +0.002, NZDUSD -0.398; gross 2.403, set at the 2026-09-21 Monday row). The research's 03_composite_weights.parquet (C_CP_all, currency space) matches the recompute at lag 0, max|diff| 2.6e-15 over 4356 rows (lag 1: 1.23), i.e. it stores decision-time weights. Next rebalance: the 2026-09-28 row, on the report as of 2026-09-22 (already cached).
